details: CONFIRMED, reproduced. _record_check builds each record finding as dict(f, verdict=..., reason=..., **extra): f is the review
finding with every field, `decided` included; extra only adds the checker's decided when its status has one. is_decided_cut
(and so open_of, outside_of) and the record_errors guard read finding["decided"] without knowing whose it is, so the
reviewer's principle answer is taken for the checker's scope cut. The design's test "An OUTSIDE without decided stays open"
was written only for a review finding with no decided. This reopens the bypass the design review's F1 HIGH closed: a MEDIUM
inside finding leaves the change without a fix and without the owner. Size: 20 minutes.
evidence: decided: F1 principle 3: derived, not stored (owner can reverse)
HIGH-REVIEW-DECIDED rc 1  relay check: nothing recorded: findings[1]: decided is refused on rank high: only a reversible scope cut ...
lib/relay_verdict.py:935-936 extra = {"decided": status["decided"]} if "decided" in status else {}; findings.append(dict(f, ...))
failing_case: Review F1: MEDIUM, kind inside, decided = "principle 3: derived, not stored (owner can reverse)" (the judge text tells the critic
to give `decided` to a principle-answered finding, with the fix the principle picks). The fixer answers "Outside: F1"; the
checker records [[status]] id = "F1", verdict = "OUTSIDE", no decided (step 6: goes to the owner).
Now: relay check record check prints "(open 0, queued 0)" and "decided: F1 principle 3: ...": the cycle lands the change with an
unfixed MEDIUM inside defect and no owner word. Should be: open 1 (an OUTSIDE without the checker's decided stays open).
Same cause, HIGH case: review F1 HIGH with a review-time decided, checker verdict OUTSIDE with no decided: refused with
"decided is refused on rank high", a decided the checker never typed, and the checker cannot record OUTSIDE at all.
fix_hint: Keep the checker's decision apart from the reviewer's: e.g. store the status's decided under its own record key (or drop the
review's `decided` from a record finding whose status is OUTSIDE without one, keeping it elsewhere for the decided: line), and
let is_decided_cut and the guard read only the checker's. Add pass cases 1 and 2 to tests/test_decided.py.
pass_cases: 1. Review F1 MEDIUM inside with review decided "principle 3: ...", check status F1 OUTSIDE without decided: recorded, open 1.
2. Review F1 HIGH inside with review decided "principle 1: ...", check status F1 OUTSIDE without decided: recorded (not refused), open 1.

3. Review F1 MEDIUM inside without decided, check status F1 OUTSIDE with decided "principle 1, scope cut: name the sender": open 0, outside 1, line "decided: F1 principle 1, scope cut: ..." (today's test, kept).
4. Review F1 MEDIUM inside with review decided, check status F1 MET: open 0 and its decided: line still printed (today's behaviour kept).
5. Check status F1 OUTSIDE with decided on a HIGH finding: refused naming rank high (kept).
reason: tests/test_decided.py test_f1_* pass, fail at base.
findings.summary: a review-time `decided` rides into the check record, so a checker's plain OUTSIDE on an inside MEDIUM finding counts as a decided cut and is not open

details: PLAUSIBLE in the front's behaviour, CONFIRMED in code: scope_cut_rest returns None for a kind-inside finding with no verdict
(the review JSON's view of a check-stage cut), so add_from takes the fix path. cycle.js finish() puts check: ck.summary and
review in the result but not the check record path; the CHECK schema has no outside count, so nothing else tells the front a
cut exists. The delegate SKILL filing table (line 247) was not updated: outside findings are "a fix item" with no --ip, so a
review-time cut filed by it lands at no ip. Brief: "the rest of a scope cut is filed as a feature at the parent item's ip".
evidence: lib/relay_queue.py:1177 scope_cut_rest: kind outside or verdict OUTSIDE required
plugins/delegate/workflows/cycle.js:277 showStage(... check: ck.summary, review, ... decided) - no record path
plugins/delegate/skills/delegate/SKILL.md:247 "wrong outside the change | a fix item: relay queue add --from <report.json> F<n> --input <file.toml>"
failing_case: The checker gives F2 (MEDIUM inside in the review) OUTSIDE with decided "principle 1, scope cut: name the sender". The cycle's
result carries only "decided: F2 principle 1, scope cut: name the sender" (no record path). The front follows SKILL.md:150,
"relay queue add --from <report.json> F2 ... --ip <parent's ip>", with the report it knows, the review JSON (the same
placeholder in plugins/delegate/skills/delegate/SKILL.md:247 means the review). There F2 is kind inside with no decided, so
add_from files a fix item "…" that ranks above every feature: the design review's F4 outcome.
Should be: a feature item "Name the sender" at the parent's ip, marked agent-chosen.
fix_hint: Have relay check record check print the record path with the decided lines (or the cycle add the check record path to the
result), say "the check record" in SKILL.md:150, and add the decided scope cut row (with --ip) to the delegate SKILL table.
pass_cases: 1. A cycle unit whose check decided F2 as a scope cut: its result names the check record path (or each decided: line carries it), and the front text tells the front to pass that path to relay queue add --from.
2. relay queue add --from <check record> F2 --ip 70: a feature "Name the sender", ip 70, why has "agent-chosen" (today's add_from, kept).
3. A review-time scope cut (review finding kind outside with decided "principle 9, scope cut: X"): filed from the review JSON as a feature, with --ip named in the delegate SKILL filing table.
4. An outside finding without decided: still filed as a fix (kept).
reason: tests/test_cycle_workflow.py test_decided_lines_of_the_check_reach_the_landed_units_result passes, errors at base; front SKILL.md:150 names check_record.
findings.summary: the rest of a check-stage scope cut has no reliable path to the queue: the front is not told the check record, and the review JSON it has files the rest as a fix

details: PLAUSIBLE: the text bounds decided to a scope cut of the item, but the code guard (the design's fact-to-code bound) checks
only rank and kind; M findings are MEDIUM kind inside with source "merge" (relay_verdict.py:727). The owner rule "a resolved
conflict still needs a green gate and a new check of the resolved files" is then guarded only by text. Size: 5 minutes.
evidence: lib/relay_verdict.py:727 M finding: severity MEDIUM, rank medium, kind inside, source merge
lib/relay_verdict.py:293 guard: rank high or kind question/design only
failing_case: Check record with M1 (MEDIUM, kind inside, source merge: "lib/x.py was changed by a merge of master after it was last
checked"). Checker status M1 OUTSIDE with decided "principle 1, scope cut: re-check lib/x.py". Now: recorded, open 0, the
resolved file lands unchecked. Should be: refused, an M finding is a re-check obligation, not part of the item.
fix_hint: Add source == "merge" (and Q) to the refused set in record_errors, with a test.

findings.summary: the code guard lets a checker decide an M finding (a file a merge of the default branch changed) as a scope cut
